name: kit-produto-mecanismo-reveal-ptbr
description: Encodes the "mechanism reveal" creative arc for Brazilian e-commerce kit products where the attachment, modularity, or interactive mechanism IS the key selling point (removable capes, detachable hoods, magnetic patches, modular bags, snap-button accessories, etc.). Opens with a cinematic hero push-in on the garment/product, cuts to an extreme macro of the attachment mechanism, then dramatically reveals the snap/attach moment in motion, closes with the fully-assembled kit hero shot and urgency CT
author: Official
